message.content:
I’m not aware of any train station in Miami that is marketed or designated specifically as “pet‑friendly.”  
However, if you’re traveling by Amtrak, the main station in the city—**Miami Central Station (Amtrak)**—does allow pets on the trains themselves (subject to Amtrak’s pet policy). The station itself doesn’t have special pet‑friendly amenities, but you can bring a small pet on board the train that departs from there. If you need more detailed information about pet policies or accommodations on the train, let me know!
